/** TABLE */
.table01 {width:100%; margin:1.5em 0; table-layout:fixed;}
.table01 th {text-align:left; vertical-align:top;}
.table01 td, .table01a td {vertical-align:top; padding-right:1.5em;}
.table01 tr:nth-child(1), .table01a tr:nth-child(1) {color:#FFFFFF; background-color:#DA291C; text-align:left;}
.table01 tr:nth-child(even), .table01a tr:nth-child(even) {background-color:#E5E5E5;}
.h401, .h401a, .h401n {margin-bottom:-1em; margin-top:0.5em;}
#golf, #golf-bio {table-layout:auto;}
#golf td, #golf-bio td{white-space: nowrap;}
#golf-bio td, #golf-bio th {font-size:0.88em;}
#preview, #schedule {table-layout:auto;}
.table-record {table-layout:auto; width:100%; margin-bottom: 1.5em;}
.table-record tr:nth-child(even) {background-color:#E5E5E5;}
.table-record th {font-size:0.70em; padding-left:2px;}
.table-record td {text-align:right; padding:0 5px; font-size:0.75em;}
#table-record-awards th, #table-record-awards td {font-size:0.85em;}
#table-record-awards th:nth-child(1) {font-size:1em;}

.table01a {width:100%; margin:1.5em 0; table-layout:auto;}
.table01a th {text-align:left; vertical-align:top; white-space: nowrap;}

.table01n {width:100%; margin:1.5em 0;}
.table01n th {text-align:left; vertical-align:top;}
.table01n td {vertical-align:top; padding-right:1.5em;}
.table01n tr:nth-child(1) {color:#FFFFFF; background-color:#DA291C; text-align:left;}
.table01n tr:nth-child(even) {background-color:#E5E5E5;}

#awards {table-layout:auto;}
#biocareer {width:88%;}
.biocareer {text-align:center; color:#DA291C; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.4rem; margin:0;}
.biocareersmall {text-align:center; color:#DA291C; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.6rem; margin:0 0 0.5rem;}


.table04a, .table-wsocrankings, .table-tennisrankings {width:100%; margin:1.5em 0;}
.table04a th, .table-wsocrankings th, .table-tennisrankings th {text-align:left; vertical-align:top; padding-left:0.25em; white-space: nowrap;}
.table04a td, .table-wsocrankings td, .table-tennisrankings td {vertical-align:top; padding-right:1.5em; padding-left:0.35em;}
.table04a tr:nth-child(1), .table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(1), .table-tennisrankings tr:nth-child(1) {color:#FFFFFF; background-color:#DA291C; text-align:left;}
.table04a tr:nth-child(even), .table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(even), .table-tennisrankings tr:nth-child(even) {background-color:#e5e5e5;}



#tickets {table-layout:fixed; max-width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin:-1em auto 1.5em;}
#tickets td {vertical-align:text-top; padding-right:2em;}
#tickets tr:nth-child(odd){background-color:#e5e5e5;}
#tickets col:nth-child(1){width:420px;}
#tickets col:nth-child(2){width:100px;}
#tickets th{font-weight:bold; text-align:left; vertical-align:text-top; padding-left:0.2em;}

@media screen and (max-width:600px)
{
#tickets {table-layout:auto; width:100%;}
#tickets td{display:block; width:100%;}
#tickets th{padding-right:5em;}
}







@media screen and (max-width:1281px) {
#golf td:nth-child(5), #golf-bio td:nth-last-child(1) {display:none;}
#preview, #schedule td {font-size:0.8rem;}
#preview, #schedule td:nth-last-child(1) {font-size:0.65rem;}
.table-record th {font-size:0.65em;}
.table-record td {font-size:0.70em;}
#table-record-awards th, #table-record-awards td {font-size:0.75em;}
#table-record-awards th:nth-child(1) {font-size:0.9em;}
}

@media screen and (max-width:975px){
.table01a tr:nth-child(n+1) th, .table01a tr:nth-child(n+1) td {font-size:0.8rem;}
#events {max-width:100%;}
#events img {width:55%;}
h1#events {font-size:1.5rem;}
h4#events {font-size:0.9rem;}
#preview td:nth-child(4) {display:none;}
.table-record th {font-size:0.60rem;}
.table-record td {font-size:0.65em;}
#table-record-awards th, #table-record-awards td {font-size:0.7rem;}
#table-record-awards th:nth-child(1) {font-size:0.85em;}
}


@media screen and (max-width:740px){
.table-record th {font-size:0.80rem;}
.table-record td {font-size:0.85em;}
#table-record-awards th, #table-record-awards td {font-size:0.8rem;}
#table-record-awards th:nth-child(1) {font-size:0.95em;}
}


@media screen and (max-width:640px){
.table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) th, .table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) td, .table-tennisrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) td {font-size:0.8rem;}
}



@media screen and (max-width:600px){
#table-block td, #golf td, #golf-bio td {display:block; text-align:left; width:100%; padding-right:0;}
.table01, .table01a {border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:auto; width:100%;}
.table01 td, .table01a td {display:inline; text-align:center; width:100%; padding-right:0;}
.table01 td:nth-last-child(1), .table01a td:nth-last-child(1) {padding-bottom:1em;}
.table01 tr:nth-child(1), .table01a tr:nth-child(1) {display:none;}
.table01 th, .table01a th {font-size:0.9rem;}
.table01a tr {text-align:center;}
.h401, .h401a {background-color:#DA291C; color:#FFFFFF;}
.table01n {border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:fixed; width:100%;}
.table01n td{text-align:left; width:100%; padding-right:0; vertical-align: middle; font-size:0.8rem;}
.table04a, .table-wsocrankings, .table-tennisrankings {border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:auto; width:100%;}
.table04a td:nth-child(n+5), .table-wsocrankings td:nth-child(3), .table-tennisrankings td:nth-child(3) {display:none;}
.table04a th, .table-wsocrankings th, .table-tennisrankings th {padding-right:10px;}
#preview td:nth-child(2), #preview td:nth-child(3) {display:none;}
#awards td {display:inline-block; text-align:left; width:100%; padding-right:0;}
#awards td:nth-last-child(1), .table01a td:nth-last-child(1) {padding-bottom:1em;}
#schedule td {display:block; text-align:left; width:100%; padding-right:0;}
}

@media screen and (max-width:539px){
.table04a tr:nth-child(n+1) th, .table04a tr:nth-child(n+1) td, .table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) th, .table-wsocrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) td, .table-tennisrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) th, .table-tennisrankings tr:nth-child(n+1) td {font-size:0.7rem;}
#biocareer {width:100%; border:none;}
}

@media screen and (max-width:440px){
#hidethis {display:none;}
.biocareer {font-size:1.2rem;}
.table-record th {font-size:0.65rem;}
.table-record td {font-size:0.7em;}
#table-record-awards th, #table-record-awards td {font-size:0.75rem;}
#table-record-awards th:nth-child(1) {font-size:0.9em;}
.table01n td{font-size:0.6rem;}
}

@media screen and (max-width:380px){
.biocareer {font-size:1rem;}
.biocareersmall {font-size:0.4rem; margin:0 0 0.5rem;}
}




/** QUOTE */
.quote01, .quote02 {padding-left:1em; margin:1.25em 2.5em 1.5em 0.25em; border-radius:6px; border-left:0.175em solid #DA291C !important; line-height:1.7em; font-size:1.11em; font-style:italic;}
#main-content > div:nth-child(1) > article > div.large-flex > div > div.sidearm-story-template-text > blockquote {border-left:0.3em solid #EEEEEE; padding-left:2em; line-height:1.7em;}

@media screen and (max-width:767px) {
.quote01, .quote02 {margin:1.25em 0 1.5em;}
}




/** TABS */
.tabs {display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; overflow:auto;}
.tabs label {order:1; display:block; padding:0.3rem 2.25rem; margin:0.2rem; cursor:pointer; color:#FFFFFF; background: #000000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1rem;}
.tabs .tab {order:99; flex-grow:1; width:100%; display:none; padding:0.5rem;}
.tabs input[type="radio"] {display:none;}
.tabs input[type="radio"]:checked + label {background:#D81E05; color:#FFFFFF;}
.tabs input[type="radio"]:checked + label + .tab {display:block;}
.details summary {color:#FFF; background-color:#DA291C; padding:1.2rem; margin-bottom:1.2rem; border-radius:0.5rem;}

/** ACCORDION */
#myaccordion {margin:0.5rem 0;}
.hidecontent {display:none;}
#myaccordion label {display:block; padding:0.25em; margin:-0.25em 0; cursor:pointer; background:#000; color:#FFF; font-size:1.1em; text-align:center; font-weight:600;}
#myaccordion label:hover {background:#DA291C;}
#myaccordion-title-last {font-size:0.5em; font-weight:600;}
#myaccordion-title-first {text-transform: uppercase;}
.content {background:#ffff; padding:0.25em 1em;}
#myaccordion input:checked + label + .content {display:block;}
.h4-accordion {margin:0 0 -0.75rem;text-align:center;}

@media screen and (max-width:1024px) {
#myaccordion-title-first {font-size:0.8em;}
#myaccordion > div > p {font-size:0.75em;}
}


/** SOCIAL MEDIA */
.instagram-media {margin:1.5em auto !important;}
.twitter-tweet, #twitter-widget-0 {margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; justify-content:center;}




/** BIOS */
* .clearfixbios::after {content: ""; clear: both; display: table;}
.flex-container-bios {display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap;}
.flex-container-bios .box-bios-big {width:70%; margin: 0 0.5em 0.25em 0; font-size: 0.9rem;}
.flex-container-bios .box-bios-small {width:30%; margin: 0.75em 0 0 0.5em; background:#F5F5F5; padding: 0.25em 1.5em;}
.flex-container-bios .box-records {width:100%;  padding:0 0.5rem;}
.flex-container-bios .box-records-two {width:100%;  padding:0 0.5rem;}

#sidearm-roster-player-bio > div > div > div > div.box-bios-small > p {margin:0.5em 0;}




  
.table-bios {table-layout:auto; width:80%; border-collapse:collapse; margin:-1em auto 0.5em;}
.table-bios thead{font-size:10px;}
.table-bios tbody{border-bottom:1.5px solid black !important;}
.table-bios>tbody tr:nth-child(odd){background-color:#e5e5e5;} 
.table-bios>thead tr:nth-child(1){background-color:#DA291C; color:#FFF;}
.table-bios th, .table-bios td{text-align:left; vertical-align:text-top; padding:0.2rem 0 0.1rem 0.25rem;} 
.table-bios>tbody th{padding-left:0.3rem;}
.table-bios>tbody td{padding-right:0.4rem;}
.table-bios>tfoot td{font-size:12px; font-weight:bold; text-align:left;}
.table-bios>tbody td:nth-child(3), .table-bios>tbody td:nth-child(4){font-size:0.85rem; line-height:1.4;}

.table-bios>tbody>tr>td>p:first-child{margin-top:0;}
.table-bios>tbody>tr>td>p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}


.h4-bios {margin-bottom:1.5rem; margin-top:1rem; text-align:center;}


#sidearm-roster-player-stats {font-size:0.75rem;}
.sidearm-table tbody tr td, .sidearm-table tbody tr th {padding: 2px 8px;}
.sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large tbody tr:nth-child(odd){background-color:#e5e5e5;}
#sidearm-roster-player-stats .sidearm-table tfoot tr {background-color:#DA291C;}

.sidearm-roster-player-template-default.sidearm-roster-player-view .sidearm-roster-player-header-select .select-button {line-height:26px; height:27px;}
.sidearm-roster-player-template-default.sidearm-roster-player-view .sidearm-roster-player-header-select select {font-size:0.85rem;}
.sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large.sidearm-table-gamehigh-stats tbody tr {background-color:#000;}
.sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large.sidearm-table-gamehigh-stats tbody td, .sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large.sidearm-table-gamehigh-stats tbody td a, .sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large.sidearm-table-gamehigh-stats tbody td a:link {color:#FFF;}
.sidearm-table-overflow-on-x-large.sidearm-table-gamehigh-stats {font-weight:600;}
.sidearm-table tbody tr:hover th:not([scope=colgroup]), .sidearm-table tbody tr:hover td, .sidearm-table tbody tr:hover th:not([scope=colgroup]) a:link, .sidearm-table tbody tr:hover td a:link, .sidearm-table tbody tr:hover th:not([scope=colgroup]) a, .sidearm-table tbody tr:hover td a {color:#000;}

@media screen and (max-width:1281px) {
.sidearm-roster-player-template-default.sidearm-roster-player-view .sidearm-roster-player-fields {font-size: 0.8rem;}
.flex-container-bios .box-bios-big, .flex-container-bios .box-records {font-size:0.8rem;}
.flex-container-bios .box-bios-big {width:65%;}
.flex-container-bios .box-bios-small {width:35%;}
}
@media screen and (max-width:1024px) {
.flex-container-bios .box-records {font-size:0.75rem;}
}

.flex-container-bios .box-bios-big, .flex-container-bios .box-bios-small {width:100%; margin: 0; font-size: 0.8rem;}
.flex-container-bios .box-records {width:100%; margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem;}
.flex-container-bios {display:block;}
} 
@media screen and (max-width:440px){
.flex-container-bios .box-records {font-size:0.7rem;}

        var CookieDate = new Date;
        CookieDate.setTime(CookieDate.getTime() + 1 * 3600 * 1000 * 24);
        document.cookie = "sidearm-adblock-banner_consent=true; expires=\"" + CookieDate.toGMTString() + "\";";
        document.querySelector(".bemeyn44u").remove();
